Operator 2026-09-28 (session s20260928T193220-3911618): speed up development — parallel subagents over the task/bug DAG, relevant tests per change, regression test per bug, then one full check after merging a batch; pre-commit as a companion; periodic (at least once per phase) bug hunt, dedupe, security and dependency upgrades; periodic architecture assessment keeping the structure clean (operator's style or default clean/hexagonal) and extracting shared code instead of duplicating it. Today bug_fixed (api/knowledge.py:321-355) only checks --regression-test is non-empty; 'watch it FAIL against the unfixed code' is prose. (a) Run the named test (the project's test runner, the node id given) against the pre-fix SOURCE (the item's base, with the new test file) and require failure, then on the current tree and require pass; (b) reuse the B15 gate-verify machinery rather than a second runner; (c) could-not-run is recorded as such, never as verified; (d) an explicit override with a reason, recorded. Test: a regression test that passes on both trees is refused.

2026-09-29: B-fix-bug-fixed-refuses-unknown adds api.knowledge._unresolved_tests (resolves each node id as a chain, in every worktree, refusing paths outside the tree). Reuse it to find the test before running it; do not parse node ids a second time.

Bug B5a009b185a (found by fixer-remedy while testing advice): 'ddflow cleanup --apply' removes a clean, merged worktree that another agent has just claimed and holds live. Destructive in the one direction ddflow promises never to go. Fix in services/cleanup.py survey/apply: a tree whose item has a live lease, or which is adopted (a harness session's own directory), is never actionable; report it as held/adopted. Regression tests: live-leased clean tree and adopted clean tree both survive --apply; fail on current code.
data.title: cleanup --apply never removes a worktree someone holds a live lease on, or an adopted one (fixes bug B5a009b185a)

data.body: All three hide a genuine double claim (the dangerous direction) and all behave identically on main; found while fixing Ba73ee6ea72. B6ac30c2acb: a holder re-acquiring its own item drops its first claim (_h_lease_acquired's not-live branch calls _hold, never _displace/_join), so a claim that overlapped the FIRST window is contested only with the second. B7164b23643: MAX_DISPLACED=8 forgets claims after nine clean handovers; a late claim overlapping the forgotten one folds to no contest and is recorded 'displaced by' a claim it never met. Bee8e21c547: a renewal by a contestant that is neither displayed nor displaced is dropped (8789/120000 folds miss a claim). Invariant to test against the oracle from tests/test_lease_contest.py: no claim that overlapped another is ever absent from the contest, in any fold order, with renewals and >8 handovers. Repros: /tmp/fuzz/repro_same_agent.py, /tmp/fuzz/repro_max_displaced.py.
data.title: Lease contests lose real overlaps in three pre-existing cases: same-holder re-claim, more than 8 handovers, a renewal by an undisplayed contestant (fixes bugs B6ac30c2acb, B7164b23643, Bee8e21c547)
